changelog.text: The Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated Ridkodub, Nove and Katerynivka, and regained control of areas near Novomykhailivka and Lypove.
The Ukrainian Armed Forces have regained control near Kalynove. The enemy has advanced near Vasylivka and Shevchenko.
The enemy has advanced near Bilytske and Shevchenko.
The enemy has occupied Svyatopetrivka and advanced near Staroukrainka.
The enemy has advanced near Kotlyne.
The enemy has occupied Ivanivka and advanced toward Nove Shakhove.

summary: Russian-controlled territory shrank by 11 km² between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-04, to 117,119 km² (19.4% of Ukraine). Source: DeepState geometry, independently measured here.
